dedupe_keys.name: ampere derived electrodynamic properties of the high latitude ionosphere

description: ADELPHI reconstructs high-latitude ionospheric electrodynamics from AMPERE field-aligned currents and estimated conductances. Its calculations include electric fields, electric potential, heating and derived geomagnetic indices. The resource is documented by Catholic University of America (CUA), Department of Physics. The documented physical domain is Geospace, High Latitude Ionosphere / Auroral Region; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The conductance reconstruction and steady-state assumptions constrain interpretation during rapidly changing storms. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
